subject: Crestview x Redwood — MAP kickoff coordination and logistics
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@crestviewhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Crestview x Redwood — MAP kickoff coordination and logistics

Hi Liam —

Great to be partnering with you on the evaluation. I wanted to get a quick Mutual Action Plan (MAP) kickoff on the calendar so we can align owners, milestones, and the evaluation criteria that determine a close. Proposed goals for the 60-minute kickoff: introductions, scope & success metrics, roles + evaluation plan, timeline to decision and blockers/risks.

Two proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Feb 23, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Feb 24, 10:00–11:00

I attached a short agenda draft and a starter attendee roster. Please confirm which window works and who will attend from Crestview. If you have a security or procurement contact who should join the kickoff for SOC2/evidence questions, please add them to the reply.

Pre-reads (short):
- MAP template (one-pager) — decisions we expect to make in the first 30 days
- Evaluation rubric (latency/cost/quality) — what Ben will walk through

Tentative Zoom link (will send calendar invite once we lock time): https://zoom.us/j/0000000000 (placeholder)
Drive folder (agenda & pre-reads): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP_agenda

Attachments: MAP_agenda_draft.pdf, MAP_attendee_roster.csv

Next steps: confirm date + attendee list and any pre-read you want added. Monica will own security/compliance discussion; Ben will walk evaluation metrics and benchmark plan.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@crestviewhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@crestviewhealth.com, security@crestviewhealth.com
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Crestview x Redwood — MAP kickoff coordination and logistics

Thanks Priyom —

Wed Feb 24, 10:00–11:00 PT works for us. Attendees on our side:
- Liam O'Connor (Product sponsor)
- Dr. Anika Rao (Head of Data)
- Marcus Lee (Infrastructure lead)

I've CC'd our contracts and security aliases so they can join or follow up with any pre-reqs. Security will want to see SOC2 evidence and your data handling summary in the first session if possible.

A couple quick asks before the kickoff:
- Can you include a one-page summary of the evaluation benchmarks you plan to run?
- Clarify whether a Dedicated capacity discussion is needed for performance-sensitive workloads (Marcus will drive).

If you can send an updated agenda and final Zoom/calendar invite, we'll confirm additional attendees.

—Liam
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@crestviewhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, security@crestviewhealth.com, contracts@crestviewhealth.com
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Crestview x Redwood — MAP kickoff coordination and logistics

Thanks Liam — locking Wed Feb 24, 10:00–11:00 PT. Calendar invite & Zoom are attached and sent (link below). Updated agenda attached (MAP_agenda_v1.pdf) and short pre-read summary included inline below.

Zoom (final): https://zoom.us/j/1234567890
Google Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=crestview-map-kickoff

Updated draft agenda (60 min):
- 0–10 min: Intros + objectives (Priyom, Liam)
- 10–25 min: Evaluation rubric & benchmarks (Ben) — acceptance thresholds for latency/cost/quality
- 25–40 min: Security/compliance overview & evidence path (Monica) — SOC2 artifacts, data flow, isolation options
- 40–55 min: Deployment options & capacity discussion (Marcus invited; Priyom to cover Dedicated vs Hosted)
- 55–60 min: Next steps & action items (assign owners + dates)

Pre-read summary (attached one-pager):
- Benchmark suite: 1) 75th/95th latency checks on sample queries, 2) cost per 1M tokens with suggested batching and quantization profiles, 3) evaluation prompts for quality regression tests
- Security docs: SOC2 scope, retention policy, audit log examples

Ben attached the short benchmark one-pager; Monica attached the list of SOC2 artifacts we can provide ahead of the call. The attendee roster file (MAP_attendee_roster.csv) is also attached.

Attachments: MAP_agenda_v1.pdf, MAP_attendee_roster.csv

If anything else needs to be included before Wed, please reply-all to this thread.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Priyom Das
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
